title: Agonist Binding Reshapes the Kinetic Landscape and Allosteric Communication of APLNR Toward Activation-Competent States.
authors: Dai, Hong; Zhu, Jun-Yao; Zhang, Bao-Dan; Liu, Meng-Ting; Sang, Peng; Yang, Li-Quan
one_liner_zh: 该文结合GaMD、MSM和NRI，系统研究了APLNR受体在激动剂结合前后的构象动力学、动力学网络和别构通讯重塑，属于典型的蛋白质构象采样与动力学计算研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: APLNR is a therapeutically important G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) implicated in cardiovascular and metabolic regulation; however, how agonist binding reorganizes receptor dynamics to promote signaling competence remains poorly understood. Here, we used the small-molecule agonist CMF-019 as a representative ligand and integrated Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics (GaMD), Markov state models (MSMs), and neural relational inference (NRI) to characterize the conformational dynamics, kinetic organization, and allosteric communication of APLNR in apo and CMF-019-bound states. We found that CMF-019 binding altered structural flexibility in extracellular and intracellular regions while modifying collective motions within the transmembrane core, indicating a transition toward a more signaling-permissive dynamic state. MSM analyses further revealed that CMF-019 binding redistributed APLNR toward activation-related intermediate conformations and accelerated transitions among metastable states. Mechanistically, NRI uncovered extensive rewiring of the receptor communication network, in which CMF-019 binding strengthened transmembrane coupling and redirected signal propagation toward more convergent signaling routes linked to intracellular functional regions. Together, these findings suggest that CMF-019 promotes APLNR signaling competence through integrated kinetic and allosteric remodeling, revealing a dynamic mechanism by which an agonist can reorganize receptor communication prior to downstream coupling.
abstract_zh: APLNR是一种具有重要治疗意义的G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR），参与心血管和代谢调节；然而，激动剂结合如何重组受体动力学以促进信号能力仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用小分子激动剂CMF-019作为代表性配体，并整合高斯加速分子动力学（GaMD）、马尔可夫状态模型（MSMs）和神经关系推断（NRI）来表征APLNR在apo态和CMF-019结合态下的构象动力学、动力学组织及变构通讯。我们发现，CMF-019结合改变了胞外和胞内区域的结构灵活性，同时修饰了跨膜核心内的集体运动，表明其向更具信号允许性的动态状态转变。MSM分析进一步揭示，CMF-019结合将APLNR重新分布至激活相关中间构象，并加速了亚稳态之间的转变。机制上，NRI揭示了受体通讯网络的广泛重连，其中CMF-019结合增强了跨膜偶联，并将信号传播重定向至与胞内功能区域相关的更趋收敛的信号通路。综合来看，这些发现表明，CMF-019通过整合动力学和变构重塑促进APLNR信号能力，揭示了一种激动剂在下游偶联前重组受体通讯的动态机制。
